name: Terror Fest
source:
After studying abroad, you return home to reunite with friends. But when they start dying, can you unmask the killer before becoming a victim?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Terror_Fest]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
出国留学后，你回到家乡与朋友团聚。但当他们开始死亡时，你能在成为受害者之前揭露凶手吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Terror_Fest]Choices Wikia[/url]]
